templates.why_chosen: This is the named overview-plus-zoomed-detail two-panel variant: nested DP/PP/Layer boxes on the left, with a dashed callout zooming one pipeline stage into CP/TP sublayers on the right, 20 components at nesting depth 3.
templates.what_to_learn: When one panel is a zoomed slice of the other rather than a comparable structure, connect them with a single dashed callout instead of forcing a second full panel frame; watch the font size once nesting reaches DP/PP/Layer/CP/TP depth, since this exemplar's own weakness is text too small for its nested detail.

templates.why_chosen: The reference guide's own named example of the zoom pattern: nested DP/PP/Layer boxes are the overview, and a dashed callout expands one pipeline stage into CP/TP sublayers on the right at nesting depth 3.
templates.what_to_learn: Mark the exact source of a zoom (one pipeline stage) before expanding it, and keep colour consistent across the boundary (navy/blue on the left reappears inside the right-hand CP/TP detail); budget bigger type than this exemplar did, since its own weakness is text too small for four nested levels.
